clue.text: Coin phrase to-represent mountain people

indicators.note: to coin is to invent or mint something new, so the following word's letters are minted afresh in a new order

explanation.surface: A request to invent a phrase that stands for a mountain community.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coin' looks like money, but here it is a verb meaning invent, the signal to rearrange the letters of PHRASE.
explanation.definitionFit: The Sherpas are a Himalayan people of Nepal, famous as climbing guides.

clue.text: Actions taken when travelling

parts.note: a lawsuit is a legal action
a court case is also a legal action

explanation.surface: Things one does while on a journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Actions' is legal, two kinds of lawsuit; the definition is something taken (carried) on a trip.
explanation.definitionFit: A suitcase is luggage that travellers carry with them.

clue.text: In delight points to an affair

parts.note: E and N are two compass points, east and north
amour is a love affair

explanation.surface: Happily pointing to a romance.
explanation.definitionFit: To enamour is to charm or captivate, filling someone with love.

clue.text: Like a tipster, stay with the man with sound credit

parts.note: a stay is a support, a prop
he is the pronoun for a man

indicators.note: the word for credit is not written but heard, giving a shorter spelling with the same sound

parts.note: on tick means on credit

explanation.surface: A racing tipster stays with a man who has a good credit rating.
explanation.walkthrough: TICK (credit, as in buying on tick) is said aloud as TIC; 'sound' looks like an adjective meaning reliable.
explanation.definitionFit: A tipster foretells results, so is predictive.

clue.text: One of Lily's family abiding in Elysium

definitions.meaning: a plant belonging to the lily family (Liliaceae)
in Greek myth this flower covered the meadows of the underworld where blessed souls dwelt

explanation.surface: Someone related to a woman called Lily lives in paradise.
explanation.definitionFit: The asphodel is a lily-family plant, and the Asphodel Meadows of Greek myth are the flowery fields of the dead.

clue.text: Irresponsible. broadcast by clever chap -a journalist

parts.note: to broadcast seed is to scatter it
a clever person is called a brain
ED is the usual short form of editor, a journalist

explanation.surface: Careless broadcasting by a smart reporter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'broadcast' suggests radio but is the farming sense of sowing seed widely.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone scatterbrained is disorganised and forgetful, not to be relied upon.

clue.text: Explosive about a foreign poet .

indicators.note: the explosive's letters go round the outside of the foreign article

parts.note: HE is short for high explosive
ein is German for a

explanation.surface: Volatile behaviour concerning a poet from abroad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'a foreign' is the German word for 'a', which suits a German poet.
explanation.definitionFit: Heinrich Heine was a German Romantic poet.

clue.text: Go down and see master for proof of qualification

parts.note: to dip is to go down briefly
lo is an old word for see or behold
MA is a Master of Arts degree

explanation.surface: Descend to visit the headmaster to obtain a certificate.
explanation.definitionFit: A diploma is a certificate awarded for completing a course of study.

clue.text: Buttercup not, often so called?

parts.note: the stout bumboat woman in Gilbert and Sullivan's HMS Pinafore bears a diminutive name though she is anything but small

explanation.definitionFit: Little Buttercup in HMS Pinafore is described by this adjective despite her size.

clue.text: Striking statistic showing moderate performance

parts.note: batting is striking, as with a bat
an average performance is a middling one

explanation.surface: A remarkable figure reveals middling results.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Striking' reads as remarkable but means hitting the ball; a cricket batting average is runs per dismissal.
explanation.definitionFit: In cricket and baseball this figure measures a hitter's typical scoring.

clue.text: Lover at a classical island retreat

indicators.note: to retreat is to go back, so the whole run of pieces is read in reverse order

parts.note: taken as written
classical here means of ancient Rome

explanation.surface: A lover is staying at an island hideaway with a classical feel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retreat' reads as a holiday hideaway but turns AT A ROMAN I backwards.
explanation.definitionFit: An inamorata is a woman who is loved, a female sweetheart.

clue.text: Fashionable place for a feed

parts.note: something fashionable is said to be in
to place something is to put it

explanation.surface: A trendy spot where one can get something to eat.
explanation.walkthrough: 'feed' suggests a meal, but here it is the data or material fed into a system.
explanation.definitionFit: Input is what is supplied or fed into a machine or process.

clue.text: Hooked on knitting

parts.note: reads as being addicted to knitting, but describes needlework that is made with a hook instead of needles

explanation.definitionFit: This craft forms looped fabric using a single hooked needle, a close cousin of knitting.

clue.text: Adjudicator in industry is in clover.

indicators.note: the referee is placed in the middle of the word for hard work

parts.note: industry as diligent hard work is toil
a referee adjudicates, shortened to ref

explanation.surface: A judge working in industry is living a comfortable life.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in clover' is an idiom for living in luxury, which disguises 'clover' as the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Clover is a three-leaved plant, and that plant genus is called by this name.

clue.text: A brace of peacock

definitions.meaning: a brace is a structural support bar
the proud swaggering walk typical of a peacock

explanation.surface: A pair of peacocks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brace' looks like a pair of birds, as game birds are counted, but it is a supporting beam.
explanation.definitionFit: A strut is a supporting bar in a framework, and also a swaggering walk like a peacock's.

clue.text: Six kings, one of them a Scandinav ian

annotationWithheld.why: Six kings, one of them a Scandinav ian (8) for NORSEMAN: no parse found for 'Six kings, one of them'; the wordplay is not recoverable and no source gives it.
annotationWithheld.clue: Six kings, one of them a Scandinav ian

clue.text: Page one is for decoding secret work

indicators.note: decoding unscrambles a message, so these letters are rearranged into a new word

explanation.surface: The first page is for cracking a code in undercover work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'decoding' fits the spy picture and signals rearranging PAGE ONE IS.
explanation.definitionFit: Espionage is spying, covert intelligence gathering.

clue.text: Quiet sanctuary for husband

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet
a nature reserve is a wildlife sanctuary

explanation.surface: A peaceful refuge for a married man.
explanation.walkthrough: 'husband' is a verb here, meaning to conserve resources, not a married man.
explanation.definitionFit: To husband something is to use it sparingly and keep it safe.

clue.text: Material for Amharic King's seat

indicators.note: the word is raw material from which something new is made, so its letters are refashioned

parts.note: R, for Latin rex, is the standard abbreviation for king

explanation.surface: Fabric used for the Ethiopian king's chair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Material for' looks like cloth but marks AMHARIC (the language of Ethiopia) as anagram fodder, giving ARMCHAI before R.
explanation.definitionFit: An armchair is a comfortable chair with side supports for the arms.

clue.text: Aries points repeatedly to ancient dynasty

parts.note: Aries is the Ram of the zodiac

indicators.note: repeatedly means the pair of compass letters appears twice in a row

parts.note: E and S are compass points, east and south

explanation.surface: The zodiac sign repeatedly points towards an old ruling family.
explanation.definitionFit: Ramesses was the name of eleven Egyptian pharaohs, grouped as a royal line.

clue.text: It may be a problem finding a sitter

definitions.meaning: someone who sits for a portrait or photograph

explanation.surface: Something might turn out to be a difficulty in locating a babysitter.
explanation.definitionFit: A poser is a tricky question, and also one who poses for an artist.

clue.text: Dishing out for a party

indicators.note: out here means put out of order, so the letters of the preceding word are rearranged

explanation.surface: Serving food for a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dishing out' reads as serving food, but 'out' signals rearranging DISHING.
explanation.definitionFit: A shindig is a lively party or celebration.

clue.text: Queen who helped give Achilles the run-around

annotationWithheld.why: Queen who helped give Achilles the run-around (6) for ESTHER: no parse found for 'give Achilles the run-around'; the wordplay is not recoverable and no source gives it.
annotationWithheld.clue: Queen who helped give Achilles the run-around

clue.text: A big shot in any unit

parts.note: any, as in 'have you any?', can be some
one is the unit of counting

explanation.surface: An important person is in every department.
explanation.definitionFit: Being someone means being an important person, a VIP.

clue.text: Circle the green in Open

parts.note: O is round like a circle
vert is the heraldic word for green

explanation.surface: Going round the putting green at the Open golf championship.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Open' suggests the golf tournament, but it is the adjective, meaning not hidden.
explanation.definitionFit: Something overt is done openly, not secretly.

clue.text: These blacks and whites are used to playing together

definitions.text: These blacks and whites are used to playing together

parts.words: These blacks and whites are used to playing together
parts.note: suggests a mixed team or a band, but describes the dark and light piano keys struck together in chords

explanation.definitionFit: Piano keys were traditionally made of elephant tusk, so the keyboard is slangily named after that material.

clue.text: East shattered following hard expedition

indicators.note: the scrambled word comes after the hard letter in the answer

parts.note: H is the abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

indicators.note: something shattered is broken into pieces, so the word's letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: The East was devastated after a tough journey.
explanation.walkthrough: 'expedition' looks like a journey, but it is the old sense of speed and promptness.
explanation.definitionFit: Expedition in its older sense means promptness or speed of action.

clue.text: King to nominate a Pope

definitions.meaning: the name of several kings, notably the Macedonian conqueror and Scottish monarchs
the name of eight popes, including the Borgia pope

explanation.surface: A monarch is about to choose a new pontiff.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to nominate' joins the two senses: it is the name both a king and a pope have borne.
explanation.definitionFit: Alexander the Great was a king of Macedon, and Alexander VI was a Renaissance pontiff.

clue.text: One of the standards established at Wisley

definitions.text: One of the standards established at Wisley

parts.words: One of the standards established at Wisley
parts.note: suggests a benchmark set at the Royal Horticultural Society's garden at Wisley in Surrey, but a standard is a shrub grown on a tall single stem

explanation.definitionFit: A standard in gardening is a plant trained to a single upright stem, and a rose so grown is called this.

clue.text: Constable's little dog

definitions.meaning: an old slang term for a policeman or detective, one who sniffs out wrongdoers
a small hound used for hunting hares

explanation.surface: A policeman's small pet dog.
explanation.definitionFit: A beagle is a small hunting hound, and was also slang for a police officer or spy.
